challenges.name: data-class-equality-copy-quiz
challenges.title: Predict it: what a data class compares and what copy() shares
challenges.description: Find out which properties take part in equals and toString, then decide what a copy of an order shares with the original.

questions.question:
What does this print?

data class CartLine(val sku: String, val qty: Int) {
    var note: String = ""
}

val a = CartLine("RAU-01", 2)
a.note = "fresh please"
val b = CartLine("RAU-01", 2)
println(a == b)
println(a)
questions.explanation: A data class generates equals, hashCode, toString, copy and the componentN functions from the properties in the PRIMARY CONSTRUCTOR only. note is declared in the class body, so it is ignored by all of them: a and b have the same sku and qty, so a == b is true, and toString prints CartLine(sku=RAU-01, qty=2) without the note. This is sometimes useful (a cache field that should not affect equality), but usually it is a bug waiting to happen: two lines with different notes are 'equal' and one of them can be dropped by a Set or a distinct().

options.text: false, then CartLine(sku=RAU-01, qty=2, note=fresh please)
true, then CartLine(sku=RAU-01, qty=2, note=fresh please)

questions.question:
After these lines, which statements are true? (Select all that apply.)

data class Order(val id: String, val items: MutableList<String>)

val first = Order("CX-1", mutableListOf("Rau muong"))
val second = first.copy(id = "CX-2")
second.items += "Trung ga ta"
questions.explanation: copy() is shallow: it creates a new Order but copies the REFERENCE to the list, so first.items and second.items are the same MutableList (=== is true), and adding to second.items changes first.items too. first == second is false because the ids differ. Destructuring follows the constructor order, so val (id, items) = second gives id = "CX-2". Two separately built orders with the same id and equal lists are equal: data class equals compares properties with ==, and lists compare their contents. hashCode() is only guaranteed to be equal for EQUAL objects; first and second are not equal (different ids), so nothing guarantees that their hash codes match.

options.text: first.items is now [Rau muong, Trung ga ta]
Order("CX-1", mutableListOf("Rau muong")) == Order("CX-1", mutableListOf("Rau muong")) is true
first.hashCode() == second.hashCode() is guaranteed, because copy() keeps the hash code

challenges.name: fix-cart-merge-and-share
challenges.title: Fix the cart that duplicates products and shares a friend's edits
challenges.description: In the Cho Xanh app, tapping + twice on the same product gives two lines of 1, because every tap loads a new Product object from the API and Product is a plain class. And 'Share my cart' gives a friend a copy that is not really a copy: when the friend removes or adds something, your cart changes too. Fix the model and share so that equal products merge into one line and a shared cart is independent of the original in both directions. The test runner reads add, share, remove and show commands and prints the carts.

tests.name: Two taps on the same product make one line of 2
tests.input:
add Lan RAU-01 15000 Rau muong
add Lan RAU-01 15000 Rau muong
add Lan TRUNG-10 30000 Trung ga ta
show Lan
tests.expected: Lan: 2 x Rau muong (30000 VND), 1 x Trung ga ta (30000 VND) | total 60000 VND

tests.name: A friend's removal stays in the friend's cart
tests.input:
add Lan RAU-01 15000 Rau muong
add Lan TRUNG-10 30000 Trung ga ta
share Lan Minh
remove Minh TRUNG-10
show Lan
show Minh
tests.expected:
Lan: 1 x Rau muong (15000 VND), 1 x Trung ga ta (30000 VND) | total 45000 VND
Minh: 1 x Rau muong (15000 VND) | total 15000 VND

tests.name: Your additions after sharing stay in your cart
tests.input:
add Lan GAO-05 240000 Gao ST25 tui 5kg
share Lan Minh
add Lan SUA-01 32000 Sua tuoi TH 1l
show Lan
show Minh
tests.expected:
Lan: 1 x Gao ST25 tui 5kg (240000 VND), 1 x Sua tuoi TH 1l (32000 VND) | total 272000 VND
Minh: 1 x Gao ST25 tui 5kg (240000 VND) | total 240000 VND

tests.name: A friend empties the shared cart
tests.input:
add Lan RAU-01 15000 Rau muong
share Lan Minh
remove Minh RAU-01
show Minh
show Lan
tests.expected:
Minh: empty
Lan: 1 x Rau muong (15000 VND) | total 15000 VND

tests.name: A cart shared twice, then edited at the end of the chain
tests.input:
add Lan RAU-01 15000 Rau muong
add Lan THIT-07 185000 Thit bo Uc
share Lan Minh
share Minh Ha
add Ha RAU-01 15000 Rau muong
remove Ha THIT-07
show Lan
show Minh
show Ha
tests.expected:
Lan: 1 x Rau muong (15000 VND), 1 x Thit bo Uc (185000 VND) | total 200000 VND
Minh: 1 x Rau muong (15000 VND), 1 x Thit bo Uc (185000 VND) | total 200000 VND
Ha: 2 x Rau muong (30000 VND) | total 30000 VND

tests.name: Interleaved taps on two products
tests.input:
add Tuan BANH-MI 25000 Banh mi pate
add Tuan CAFE-02 29000 Ca phe sua da
add Tuan BANH-MI 25000 Banh mi pate
add Tuan CAFE-02 29000 Ca phe sua da
